clue.text: Criticise Dame blocking demands for way to identify comedian?

indicators.note: the pair stands in the way inside CALLS, splitting it

blocks.note: to pan a show is to criticise it
DBE, Dame Commander of the Order of the British Empire
calls = demands; PAN DBE goes inside after CA

explanation.surface: A critic sets about a pantomime dame who is getting in the way of a comic's needs.
explanation.walkthrough: The title Dame is abbreviated DBE, the honour that confers it. The cap and bells was the court jester's headgear, so it marked out the comedian of the court.
explanation.definitionFit: The belled cap was the jester's badge of office, the thing that identified the court comedian.

clue.text: Efficient secretary blocking message

indicators.note: PA sits inside CABLE, stopping it up

blocks.note: PA = personal assistant; goes inside CA…BLE

explanation.surface: A capable secretary intercepts a message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Efficient secretary' reads as one phrase, but 'Efficient' is the definition and the secretary is only PA.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: someone who gets the job done well is both.

clue.text: Furious policeman receiving nothing in support — one’s a source of repeated documents

definitions.text: one’s a source of repeated documents

indicators.note: HOT COP takes O in between its parts
the whole lot sits inside PIER

blocks.note: a pier supports a bridge; it wraps round the rest after its P

explanation.surface: An angry officer ends up with nothing in the way of backing.
explanation.walkthrough: Two insertions stack: O goes into HOT COP, then HOTOCOP goes into PIER as P…IER.
explanation.definitionFit: A photocopier turns out copy after copy of a document.

clue.text: Prompt, say, with plague on the rise

clue.text: Delivery documentation variously bathetic and terrific

explanation.walkthrough: 'Delivery' sounds like parcels and couriers; here it is the delivery of a baby.

clue.text: Sprang around most of field, like many rabbits?

blocks.note: loped = bounded along; it wraps round the field after LOPE

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures a rabbit bounding round a field, and the answer is a rabbit's feature.
explanation.definitionFit: A definition by example: lops are rabbit breeds whose ears hang down.

clue.text: Be prepared for a row or this phase goes awry

indicators.note: the phrase goes wrong, its letters out of order

explanation.walkthrough: 'A row' reads as a quarrel; it is rowing a boat.

clue.text: Secured maximum value from statistics?

clue.text: Frivolous, dissipated, welcoming British drizzle

clue.text: Abandon some surgery led by doctor

clue.text: Indecently humorous as BA airline flounders

clue.text: Literary genre initially lacking in motion, mostly calm

clue.text: Not at the front, a runner’s last to secure prize? On the contrary

clue.text: German article on learner in school, not the brightest one?

clue.text: Flowering plant Paul replanted around border

clue.text: Bitter passion involving Bishop recalled in account

clue.text: That man about to get taken aback for a time

clue.text: Damage unknown following on agreement

clue.text: He or I perhaps will lead a railway — that’s obvious

clue.text: Check opening article with list and come up with nothing new
